chunks: From him, from al-Hasan, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Jamil ibn Darrāj, from Zurārah, from Abū Ja‘far عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about the witr that a man misses. He said: He should make up one witr always.

key_terms.الرَّجُلَ: a man, meaning the legally responsible person in this context
key_terms.الْوِتْرِ: the witr prayer, the odd-numbered night prayer
key_terms.وَتْرًا: one witr unit as the form of make-up
key_terms.يَفُوتُ: is missed or passes by without being performed
key_terms.يَقْضِي: he performs it as a make-up prayer

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if he misses the witr prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the missed witr prayer. It states that if a man misses the witr, he should continue to make it up as a single witr prayer.
